component.name: Watch Health
component.summary: See the health data of your watch

description.p: Watch Health shows the data that Amazfish downloads from your smartwatch, on a Phosh phone and on the desktop. It reads Amazfish's database and never changes it; it needs no account and no network.

ul.li: Today at a glance: steps, resting heart rate, sleep, stress, heart rate variability, blood oxygen, skin temperature and PAI
Every value by day, week, month and year
Your own normal range instead of population averages
Workouts with their numbers and the heart rate during them
Follows every sync of Amazfish by itself

description.p: Watch Health is an independent project and not affiliated with the Amazfish project or the watch maker. It is not a medical device.
